name: PM MUDRA - Shishu
description: Micro-credit for small income-generating businesses requiring loans up to Rs. 50,000.
benefit: Collateral-free institutional credit up to Rs. 50,000.
eligibility_text: Available to eligible micro enterprises engaged in income-generating activities.
documents_required: KYC documents, business documents and documents required by the lending institution.

name: PM MUDRA - Kishore
description: Credit support for micro enterprises requiring more than Rs. 50,000 and up to Rs. 5 lakh.
benefit: Collateral-free institutional credit above Rs. 50,000 and up to Rs. 5 lakh.
eligibility_text: Available to eligible micro enterprises engaged in income-generating activities.
documents_required: KYC documents, business documents and documents required by the lending institution.

name: PM MUDRA - Tarun
description: Credit support for micro enterprises requiring more than Rs. 5 lakh and up to Rs. 10 lakh.
benefit: Collateral-free institutional credit above Rs. 5 lakh and up to Rs. 10 lakh.
eligibility_text: Available to eligible micro enterprises engaged in income-generating activities.
documents_required: KYC documents, business documents and documents required by the lending institution.

name: PM MUDRA - Tarun Plus
description: Credit support above Rs. 10 lakh and up to Rs. 20 lakh for eligible entrepreneurs who have successfully repaid a previous Tarun-category loan.
benefit: Collateral-free credit above Rs. 10 lakh and up to Rs. 20 lakh.
eligibility_text: Applicant must have previously availed and successfully repaid a Tarun-category MUDRA loan.
documents_required: KYC documents, previous loan repayment records and business documents.

name: Prime Minister Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
description: Credit-linked subsidy programme for setting up new micro enterprises in the non-farm sector.
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises
benefit: Credit-linked margin money subsidy ranging from 15% to 35% depending on applicant category and location.
eligibility_text: Individual applicants must be above 18 years. New project assistance has no income ceiling.
documents_required: KYC documents, project report, educational qualification documents where applicable and bank/implementing-agency documents.

name: PMEGP 2nd Loan for Upgradation
description: Financial support for upgrading and expanding eligible existing PMEGP units.
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises
benefit: Margin money subsidy for eligible expansion and upgradation of existing units.
eligibility_text: Existing units must satisfy the applicable performance and repayment conditions.
documents_required: Previous loan records, KYC, project report, financial records and bank documents.

name: PM Vishwakarma
description: Support programme for traditional artisans and craftspeople working with their hands and tools in identified traditional trades.
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises
benefit: Enterprise loans up to Rs. 3 lakh in two tranches, toolkit incentive, training, digital incentives and marketing support.
eligibility_text: Available to eligible artisans and craftspeople working in the identified traditional trades.
documents_required: KYC documents, beneficiary verification and trade-related documents required under the scheme.

name: PM SVANidhi
description: Collateral-free working capital support for eligible street vendors through progressive loan tranches.
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
benefit: Working capital loans through progressive tranches of Rs. 15,000, Rs. 25,000 and Rs. 50,000.
eligibility_text: Available to eligible street vendors under the PM SVANidhi framework.
documents_required: Vendor identification, KYC documents and documents required by the implementing authority/lender.

name: NSFDC Micro Finance Scheme (MFS)
description: Concessional micro-credit for income-generating activities for eligible Scheduled Caste beneficiaries.
benefit: Financing up to 90% of project cost with a maximum loan of Rs. 1.25 lakh at 6.5% beneficiary interest.
eligibility_text: Applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste community and satisfy the applicable family-income ceiling.
documents_required: Caste certificate, income proof, KYC documents and documents required by the channelizing agency.

name: NSFDC Aajeevika Micro-Finance Yojana (AMY)
description: Micro-finance support through selected NBFC-MFIs for eligible Scheduled Caste beneficiaries.
benefit: Financing up to 90% of project cost with a maximum loan of Rs. 1.25 lakh at 15% beneficiary interest.
eligibility_text: Applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste community and satisfy the applicable family-income ceiling.
documents_required: Caste certificate, income proof, KYC documents and documents required by the implementing NBFC-MFI.

name: NSFDC Term Loan Scheme
description: Concessional term finance for larger income-generating projects of eligible Scheduled Caste beneficiaries.
benefit: Financing up to 90% of project cost with a maximum loan of Rs. 45 lakh at 8% beneficiary interest.
eligibility_text: Applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste community and satisfy the applicable family-income ceiling.
documents_required: Caste certificate, income proof, KYC documents, project report and channelizing-agency documents.

name: NSFDC Udyam Nidhi Yojana (UNY)
description: Financing support for small income-generating activities through eligible cooperative institutions and small finance banks.
benefit: Maximum loan of Rs. 4.5 lakh for projects costing up to Rs. 5 lakh. Interest terms depend on the implementing channel.
eligibility_text: Applicant must satisfy the applicable NSFDC Scheduled Caste and income eligibility requirements.
documents_required: Caste certificate, income proof, KYC documents, project/business documents and channel-specific requirements.
